title: Preserve same-session mark authorship when reusing evaluations after reopen
outcome: Imported evaluation eligibility recovers the same origin-qualified mark author as native evaluation when a task is reopened with its same-session mark unchanged.
acceptance: A retained evaluation after reopening a task with an unchanged same-session mark uses the origin-qualified item's creation/revision mark history independently of current-run holder history, matching native authorship and ordering rules.

A behavioral regression covers an unaffiliated earlier-run mark author, completion/reopen and a valid new-run same-session evaluation, plus refusal when mark authorship is genuinely unavailable; restored/detached and genuinely changed marks retain their existing safety rules.

completion.summary: Preserve origin-qualified item mark authorship across completion/reopen without widening current-run holder history.
